The Rha is a light carrier destroyer whose swept feather-plate wings and gilded sun disc recall the falcon of the old solar cults. Two hangar bays sit beneath the forward wings, flanked by shielded gold-trimmed armor, while a pair of energy turrets on the wing shoulders and two missile pods near the engines provide a modest screen.

Rha crews fly fast and fight behind their wings: the carrier darts between flights, trailing a golden exhaust, and lets its fighters do the killing.
